Start forces. PLAYER (41): INF4 MECH4 TANK4 MDT3 NEO2 ART3 ROCK2 MIS2 AA3 RECON2 APC2 FTR2 BMB1 BCO2 CR2 SUB1 LAN1. VARRO (69): NEO4 MEGA2 MDT6 TANK4 RECON2 ART6 ROCK3 MIS2 AA4 INF8 MECH6 APC2 FTR3 BMB3 BCO2 BS2 CR3 SUB2 LAN2; hold: keep INF2 MECH1, gate guns ART6 ROCK3 MIS2 AA4, INF1 at (7,14), MECH1 at (22,14); everything else advances (armour on the south corridors and the lower town, aircraft at the airports (10,3) (19,3), fleet in the NE inlet). PRAETORIAN (31): NEO3 MDT4 TANK3 ART3 INF6 MECH4 AA2 FTR2 BCO1; hold ART3 AA2 INF3 MECH2 at the east gate and harbour, the rest advances. Geography: three phases. (1) Harbour and lower town y17..22 (rows between the moat y=23 and the outer ring), harbour bay x>=32. (2) Walls: mountain rings outer x4..25 y1..16 (gates W (4,13) S (13,16) E (25,9)), middle x8..21 y4..13 (gates W (8,6) S (17,13) E (21,11)), inner x11..18 y6..11 (gates W (11,9) S (12,11) E (18,8)); no two gates line up so every ring is a zigzag along 1-3 cell corridors. (3) Keep (12..17, 7..10) with HQ (15,8) and keep cities (13,7) (16,7) (13,10) (16,10). Moat: river y=23 from the west edge to the sea at (23,23); three single-lane bridges (2,23) west road, (13,23) causeway, (19,23) east. Lanes: west road x=2 to the west gate; causeway road x=13 to the south gate; east bridge to the main street y=20 and the east coast road x=26 to the east gate and Varro's quays; air lane from the NE airfield (29,9) and Varro's airports; sea lane from the player's port (22,26) up the east bay x>=32. Back route: quay road x=26 to the north rim y=0 and west to the west lane. Threat/answer: Neotanks/Megatanks/Md Tanks on the bridges -> the moat is the choke: Md Tanks, Neotanks, Artillery and Rockets behind it, Missiles/AA for the air; walls' Artillery/Rockets/Missiles (hold) -> Recons to find them, Bombers/Fighters from the airport (5,27), Infantry/Mechs over the mountains to the guns, own Artillery range, the three-ring zigzag lets Tanks shoot from outside; Fighters and Bombers from (10,3) (19,3) and (29,9) -> 3 AA + 2 Missiles + 2 Fighters, the player can build AA/Missiles/Fighters at 2 bases and the airport; Battleships/Cruisers shelling the east coast road -> Bombers and Subs, 2 Cruisers + Sub from the player's port, Lander landing at the east beach (shoal x=32 rows 12..18, sand x 27..31) or the islet (shoal x=27 rows 25..27, sand x 28..31) behind the fleet; Subs -> Cruisers; Landers/marines -> Cruisers, Tanks at the beach; Praetorian Neotanks on the east strip -> hold the east bridge, use Missiles/Artillery on the main street.'
